origin.description: Path of the user Makevars file.
origin.details: On Unix, R_MAKEVARS_USER when that file exists, otherwise ~/.R/Makevars-<R_PLATFORM>, otherwise ~/.R/Makevars. An empty result is character(0).
origin.example: f <- tempfile(); writeLines("X=1", f); Sys.setenv(R_MAKEVARS_USER=f); makevars_user()

translation.description: Path of the user Makevars file.
translation.details: The same search. An empty result is an empty string, which stands for character(0).
translation.value: A path, or an empty string.
translation.example:
import os, tempfile
from tools import makevars_user
path = tempfile.mktemp()
open(path, "w").write("X=1\n")
os.environ["R_MAKEVARS_USER"] = path
print(makevars_user())
